response.justification: Bogdan has deep technical expertise, strong open-source contributions, and broad experience across stacks and architectures, but lacks demonstrated leadership in IT consulting, formal project management, and UML modeling — and his German is only basic, falling short of the C1 requirement.
strengths: Extensive open-source contributions with GISCollective and DLang tools
Proven full-stack engineering across diverse technologies and domains
Strong track record of mentoring and conducting technical workshops
concerns: German language proficiency is only basic, not meeting C1 requirement
No explicit evidence of IT architecture design or UML modeling experience
Lacks documented experience in client-facing consulting or requirements management
